cvs.text: Full-stack software developer with skills in cloud, API, SQL, Python, software engineering, testing, and data analytics. Experienced in monitoring operations and analysing logs to resolve workflow issues, demonstrated by tracking waste trends to reduce errors. Skilled in documenting operational processes and drafting clear guides, having created a one-page procedure with mistake examples to ensure correct ordering. Experienced in coaching team members through practical walkthroughs to maintain operational continuity and prevent duplicate processing.

Detail-oriented professional with experience in spreadsheet reporting, data recording, and practical testing. Skilled at monitoring system outputs, isolating operational discrepancies through controlled testing, and verifying equipment before returning it to service. Proven ability to document technical procedures by creating setup guides featuring diagrams, ordered checks, and handling instructions for unusual results. Strong focus on testing documentation clarity with team members to ensure robust error handling and safe procedural execution.

Experienced operations coordinator skilled in business tools, stock tracking, and workflow management. Proficient in monitoring operational logs and spreadsheet data to identify overdue items, service trends, and recurring tool failures. Experienced in resolving service interruptions by diagnosing root causes, coordinating replacements, and updating user guidance. Skilled in creating operational checklists and runbooks, training team members through practical simulations to prioritize safety checks and maintain standard operating procedures.

Organised operations lead experienced in practical testing, process mapping, and workflow optimisation. Skilled at reviewing service procedures, removing administrative redundancies, and establishing single sources of truth for operational tracking. Experienced in authoring clear instructions and runbooks, testing procedures with team members, and updating guides based on direct feedback and edge-case questions. Adept at coordinating operational changes and maintaining shared documentation during unexpected disruptions.

Full-stack software developer experienced in cloud, APIs, SQL, Python, testing, and data analytics. Experienced in establishing automated checks, grouping failure trends across environments, and updating testing runbooks and checklists to catch issues before release, ensuring reliable service operations and transparent reporting.

Data reporting specialist experienced in business tools, PostgreSQL databases, and SQL querying. Proficient in reviewing system records, reconciling operational datasets, and tracing discrepancies back to original transactions to ensure data integrity. Technical developer experienced in JavaScript web tools, practical testing, and system maintenance.
